+

Nesting depth — loop.depth

+

+ {t("{{loop.depth}}")} is the 1-based loop-nesting level: the outermost + {t("{{#each}}")} is 1, a loop nested directly inside it is 2, + and so on. It counts enclosing loops only (a {t("{{#with}}")}/{t("{{#if}}")} + between two loops does not bump it), and {t("loop.parent.depth")} is the enclosing loop's — + handy for indentation in a nested or tree render. Unlike {t("label NAME")} it needs no clause. +

+

The empty case

{t("{{#each}}")} carries its own {t("{{else}}")} for an empty list — inherited from ClassicBars.
